learning_extracted: The -1.19 seed (456) is a numerical-instability artifact, not a negative-transfer weakens: world head diverged while affordance head improved; grad-norm spike; mean delta positive; weakens gate (mean<=0) not entered.

world_R2 unbounded-below + no grad clipping is a margin-poisoning measurement defect: one divergent seed dominates the across-seed delta SD and renders the hardened margin un-passable even with 2/3 seeds strongly super-additive.
The R1 cosine negative-transfer guard is inert as wired (disjoint-slice probe -> cosine identically 0.0); it must probe gradient alignment on shared encoder parameters to be able to fire.
The hardened delta-scaled + floored margin works as intended: it flips 680a's false PASS to a correct inconclusive on identical data and is strictly tighter (cannot manufacture a false PASS).
n=3 is underpowered for a 2-of-3 reliability margin once instability is present.
